♪ my neo neighborhood

♪ build your own website! (HTML HELP + POPULAR SITE ADDITIONS)

this site is, quite literally, the best thing i've ever made. it's a culmination of who i am, and i'm grateful for all of the people i've met on here. it would be a crime for me to keep all of this HTML information to myself. i urge you, if you are inbetween making a site and not, DEFINITELY DO IT!!! and also here's some websites to get you started :)
  1. sadgrl's HTML cheatsheet // she also offers templates!
  2. W3 schools // my literal lifesaver. anything you need for HTML/CSS is here
  3. r/neocities (reddit) // so many helpful people & FRQ are here!
other bits & bobs that may help you on your journey (popular site additions)
  1. status.cafe // status updates for your website
  2. Mabland's Rating Pandas // add a rating to your website, G - NR status
  3. tomaNOTchi world // interactive tomagotchi that is fed by site viewers
  4. gifypet // fully customizable pet that can be fed, showred, etc.
  5. imood // mood tracker, displays on website like status.cafe
